title: Computational pathology assessments of cardiac stromal remodeling: Clinical correlates and prognostic implications in heart transplantation
venue: JHLT Open 7:100202; online December 2024, issue February 2025
study_context: Single-center retrospective cohort described as 2167 H&E transplant EMB slides from 650 patients (1999-2016); 265 quality exclusions are additionally reported without a reconciled analyzed-slide count in this review.
population_or_data: Single-center retrospective cohort described as 2167 H&E transplant EMB slides from 650 patients (1999-2016); 265 quality exclusions are additionally reported without a reconciled analyzed-slide count in this review.
task: Single-center retrospective cohort described as 2167 H&E transplant EMB slides from 650 patients (1999-2016); 265 quality exclusions are additionally reported without a reconciled analyzed-slide count in this review.
method: 210 stromal features, with mixed-effects analysis of patient/time trajectories and outcome-associated selection of five features.
main_findings: The study excluded currently high-grade ACR, pAMR >=1 and treated rejection from study biopsies, then analyzed stromal morphology over time against prior inflammatory histories and subsequent allograft-loss/CAV outcomes.
The authors report limited routine AMR immunostaining and historical diagnostic-label variability; the cohort is single-center and the analysis links repeated biopsies to patient-level outcomes.
limitations: Selected-page methods/results/limitations review; text and rendered PDF pages 1, 2, 3, 6, 10 checked on 2026-10-07. Not a complete paper/supplement audit.
Published article; stable ID retains online year 2024, bibliographic issue year 2025.
Not a validated predictor of current ACR or proof that local negative biopsies contain rejection. Outcome-selected features and associations are not independent held-out predictive performance.

No causal effect of immunosuppression changes or external clinical validation. Composite CAV severity is written as >=2 in cohort methods but >2 elsewhere; no exact event-rate or threshold claim is indexed.
does_not_establish: Not a validated predictor of current ACR or proof that local negative biopsies contain rejection. Outcome-selected features and associations are not independent held-out predictive performance.

No causal effect of immunosuppression changes or external clinical validation. Composite CAV severity is written as >=2 in cohort methods but >2 elsewhere; no exact event-rate or threshold claim is indexed.
relevance_to_project: Supports a separate longitudinal tissue-remodeling question using biopsies without current serious rejection, conditional on dated clinical outcomes. Supports explicit separation of complete pAMR confirmation, histologic findings, historical rejection labels and clinical outcomes in SMC.
